scopeObservations: The paper contains three picture-identification items, seven basic-response items, and eleven short-dialogue comprehension items.

All five rendered pages and all twenty-seven official audio members were inspected; the twenty-one item tracks were decoded twice with independent local models before manual option analysis and answer comparison.
resolvedFindings: The two independent audio decodes differed on a few proper names and section cues, but the tested propositions and all twenty-one independently derived answers were stable and matched the official key.
